daily.title: Hacking attempts surge as websites race to patch PHP issues
daily.summary: A cloud firm says millions of hacking attempts have been made since critical vulnerabilities were revealed in software used on 70 per cent of the world's websites.

daily.title: Zelenskyy says fresh Russian strikes show 'no change' in Kremlin position
daily.summary: Russia pounded Kyiv with ballistic missiles and Ukraine sent hundreds of drones towards Moscow overnight despite the latest US push to end the conflict.

daily.title: Shark trapped in South Korean city won't return to sea
daily.summary: Although "Bukangi" has become a mascot for the city of Busan, everyone agrees the dusky shark should go back to the open sea. But getting her to leave is proving difficult.

daily.title: Chalmers says investors feel good about Australia despite gloom at home
daily.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers hails positive news for business investment, despite domestic gloom over inflation and productivity.

daily.title: Nationals leader set to attempt switch to lower house
daily.summary: Nationals MP Michelle Landry is expected to announce on Friday that she will retire from federal politics at the next election.

daily.title: Snowy 2.0 to cost 12 times more than initial budget with further delays
daily.summary: Australia's biggest renewable energy project, which has faced financial and timeline challenges since its inception, could now cost $25 billion and is expected to be delivered in late 2029.

daily.title: NT government accused of politicising Kumanjayi Little Baby's death
daily.summary: The Northern Territory government has used its parliamentary majority to pass a motion condemning Chansey Paech for comments he made to the media about Kumanjayi Little Baby on Tuesday.

daily.title: Police investigating death of woman and child in Melbourne's east
daily.summary: Detectives are investigating the circumstances around the death of a woman and a child in Melbourne's east.

daily.title: Man charged over WA MP threats says weapon was musical instrument
daily.summary: A man charged over an allegedly threatening incident at Labor MP Hannah Beazley's electorate office tells a Perth court he was holding a musical instrument, not a weapon, as police allege.

daily.title: Affordable home scheme went from 'blessing' to 'disaster', buyers say
daily.summary: Buyers of properties in this Canberra suburb say they have been left stranded as they grapple with incomplete works while locked in contractual disputes with the builder.

daily.title: 'Reprehensible': The Trump money grab that disgusts former adviser
daily.summary: Donald Trump's former shortest serving press secretary adds to concerns the US President has let the nation down, while making allegations surrounding corruption.

daily.title: Relatives of Elizabeth Struhs speak at final day of inquest
daily.summary: The inquest has been examining whether various government agencies' responses to the eight-year-old's child protection case were adequate before her death in 2022.

daily.title: Australia falls to defeat in final session, South Africa levels series
daily.summary: South Africa battled the weather and a resilient Australian rearguard to win the second Test in Gqeberha by an innings and 31 runs to level the series at 1-1.

daily.title: PM was planning golf club photo-op when news of his membership broke
daily.summary: Anothony Albanese's office was planning a photo opportunity to celebrate a $6 million grant to the Marrickville Golf Club days before the ABC revealed his undisclosed honorary membership.

daily.title: Disgraced former AFL footballer Nick Stevens to remain behind bars
daily.summary: Former AFL player Nick Stevens fails in his bid to have his prison term set aside after previously being found guilty by a jury of fraud-related charges.

daily.title: Helen Haines remains critical, three days after car attack
daily.summary: Floral tributes have continued to be added outside Ms Haines's Wangaratta office, with grief still raw among local and interstate visitors alike.

daily.title: Two years after promised change, forced adoption survivors are still waiting
daily.summary: For decades, thousands of unmarried women were pressured or forced to surrender their babies for adoption. Two years since a WA report into the practice, survivors are frustrated with the pace of change.

daily.title: 'Tireless advocate' Pat Miller to be honoured with state funeral
daily.summary: The trailblazing legacy of Patricia Ann Miller AO, a proud Arrernte woman and former NT Australian of the Year, will be honoured with a state funeral.

daily.title: Schutt banned for two matches after prescription medication failure
daily.summary: Australian women's star fast bowler Megan Schutt apologises for a breach of prescription medication guidelines.

daily.title: Colombian narcotics police 'have no record' of AFP anti-drugs taskforce
daily.summary: Two Colombian National Police departments say they have no evidence of an agreement with the Australian Federal Police for its newly-announced international anti-drugs taskforce.

daily.title: KPMG ban on government work extended after 'serious ethical failings'
daily.summary: The federal government extends its ban on KPMG bidding for new government work until at least the end of February, following allegations its audit partners misused client data then mishandled a whistleblower's complaint.

daily.title: Accused 'dead set' he was not driving in crash that killed four
daily.summary: A 25-year-old man has taken the stand in the Dubbo District Court, where he is on trial after pleading not guilty to dangerous and drink-driving charges over a crash on the Newell Highway that killed four people.

daily.title: 'She became younger': Gascoigne's success at 57
daily.summary: Despite her reputation today as one of Australia's most influential artists, Rosalie Gascoigne did not start exhibiting any of her work until she was aged 57.

daily.title: SA mother spared jail for 6yo daughter's death in car crash
daily.summary: A mother who got lost on the way to church before failing to give way at an intersection – causing a crash which killed her own child – will not be sent to prison, a court has heard.

daily.title: Accused killer tells court fellow prisoner threw faeces on him
daily.summary: Accused High Country killer Greg Lynn tells a court he has had been attacked with faeces and bodily fluids during his time in custody, as he seeks bail ahead of a trial next year.

developing.summary: Anthony Albanese reveals he had personally intervened ahead of the tax office's decision to delay a credit card ban after a plea from a peak business lobby. Follow live.

developing.summary: The Greens say WA senator Jordon Steele-John has taken leave after reports of allegations that he made inappropriate comments towards women.
